hebrewText: וַ/יַּשְׁכֵּ֣ם אַבְרָהָ֣ם בַּ/בֹּ֡קֶר וַ/יִּֽקַּֽח לֶחֶם֩ וְ/חֵ֨מַת מַ֜יִם וַ/יִּתֵּ֣ן אֶל הָ֠גָר שָׂ֧ם עַל שִׁכְמָ֛/הּ וְ/אֶת הַ/יֶּ֖לֶד וַֽ/יְשַׁלְּחֶ֑/הָ וַ/תֵּ֣לֶךְ וַ/תֵּ֔תַע בְּ/מִדְבַּ֖ר בְּאֵ֥ר שָֽׁבַע

tokens.bdb: literally, to load up (on the back of man or beast), i.e. to start early in the morning
tokens.kjv: (arise, be up, get (oneself) up, rise up) early (betimes), morning.

tokens.bdb: Abraham, the later name of Abram
tokens.kjv: Abraham.

tokens.bdb: properly, dawn (as the break of day); generally, morning
tokens.kjv: ([phrase]) day, early, morning, morrow.

tokens.bdb: to take (in the widest variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: accept, bring, buy, carry away, drawn, fetch, get, infold, [idiom] many, mingle, place, receive(-ing), reserve, seize, send for, take (away, -ing, up), use, win.

tokens.bdb: food (for man or beast), especially bread, or grain (for making it)
tokens.kjv: (shew-) bread, [idiom] eat, food, fruit, loaf, meat, victuals.

tokens.bdb: a skin bottle (as tied up)
tokens.kjv: bottle.

tokens.bdb: water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen
tokens.kjv: [phrase] piss, wasting, water(-ing, (-course, -flood, -spring)).

tokens.bdb: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
tokens.kjv: add, apply, appoint, ascribe, assign, [idiom] avenge, [idiom] be (healed), bestow, bring (forth, hither), cast, cause, charge, come, commit, consider, count, [phrase] cry, deliver (up), direct, distribute, do, [idiom] doubtless, [idiom] without fail, fasten, frame, [idiom] get, give (forth, over, up), grant, hang (up), [idiom] have, [idiom] indeed, lay (unto charge, up), (give) leave, lend, let (out), [phrase] lie, lift up, make, [phrase] O that, occupy, offer, ordain, pay, perform, place, pour, print, [idiom] pull, put (forth), recompense, render, requite, restore, send (out), set (forth), shew, shoot forth (up), [phrase] sing, [phrase] slander, strike, (sub-) mit, suffer, [idiom] surely, [idiom] take, thrust, trade, turn, utter, [phrase] weep, [phrase] willingly, [phrase] withdraw, [phrase] would (to) God, yield.

tokens.bdb: near, with or among; often in general, to
tokens.kjv: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).

tokens.bdb: Hagar, the mother of Ishmael
tokens.kjv: Hagar.

tokens.bdb: to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] any wise, appoint, bring, call (a name), care, cast in, change, charge, commit, consider, convey, determine, [phrase] disguise, dispose, do, get, give, heap up, hold, impute, lay (down, up), leave, look, make (out), mark, [phrase] name, [idiom] on, ordain, order, [phrase] paint, place, preserve, purpose, put (on), [phrase] regard, rehearse, reward, (cause to) set (on, up), shew, [phrase] stedfastly, take, [idiom] tell, [phrase] tread down, (over-)turn, [idiom] wholly, work.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to put (used in a great variety of applications
tokens.enLiteralWord: to put (used in a great variety of applications
tokens.explanation: to put (used in a great variety of applications
tokens.explanationEn: to put (used in a great variety of applications

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.

tokens.bdb: the neck (between the shoulders) as the place of burdens; figuratively, the spur of ahill
tokens.kjv: back, [idiom] consent, portion, shoulder.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: the neck  as the place of burdens; figuratively
tokens.enLiteralWord: the neck  as the place of burdens; figuratively
tokens.explanation: the neck  as the place of burdens; figuratively
tokens.explanationEn: the neck  as the place of burdens; figuratively

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).

tokens.bdb: something born, i.e. a lad or offspring
tokens.kjv: boy, child, fruit, son, young man (one).

tokens.bdb: to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] any wise, appoint, bring (on the way), cast (away, out), conduct, [idiom] earnestly, forsake, give (up), grow long, lay, leave, let depart (down, go, loose), push away, put (away, forth, in, out), reach forth, send (away, forth, out), set, shoot (forth, out), sow, spread, stretch forth (out).

tokens.bdb: to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] again, away, bear, bring, carry (away), come (away), depart, flow, [phrase] follow(-ing), get (away, hence, him), (cause to, made) go (away, -ing, -ne, one's way, out), grow, lead (forth), let down, march, prosper, [phrase] pursue, cause to run, spread, take away (-journey), vanish, (cause to) walk(-ing), wax, [idiom] be weak.

tokens.bdb: to vacillate, i.e. reel or stray (literally or figuratively); also causative of both
tokens.kjv: (cause to) go astray, deceive, dissemble, (cause to, make to) err, pant, seduce, (make to) stagger, (cause to) wander, be out of the way.

tokens.bdb: a pasture (i.e. open field, whither cattle are driven); by implication, a desert; also speech (including its organs)
tokens.kjv: desert, south, speech, wilderness.

tokens.bdb: Beer-Sheba, a place in Palestine
tokens.kjv: Beer-shebah.
